name: Kisaragi no Hougyoku
source:
Toru Fujiwara, who transferred to Sangu high school met a beautiful girl named Yuri on the first day.
At the same time, a new girl named Rita came from Scotland with a secret goal in her mind.
Toru enjoys his school life with Yuri and Rita.
But he is getting involved in battle for Kisaragi-no-Hogyoku (Gemma Februarii).

[from [url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/kisaragi-no-hogyoku-eng/id483859470]iTunes[/url]]
translation:
转入三宫高中的藤原彻，在第一天便遇见了一名叫百合的美丽少女。
与此同时，一名叫丽塔的新生也怀着秘密目的从苏格兰来到这里。
彻与百合、丽塔共同享受着校园生活，
却逐渐被卷入围绕“如月宝玉”（Gemma Februarii）展开的争斗。

[摘自[url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/kisaragi-no-hogyoku-eng/id483859470]iTunes[/url]]
